==Skins==
{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:HallowGuardLunar1.png|200px]]
|Made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid.

Brown belt, grey shoulder-pads, crown and a chestplate, which as a black skull with neon blue eyes on it.

Does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage.

Has two large neon blue eyeholes, with flames coming out of them.
}}
|Mage
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:MageHallowGuard.png|200px]]
|Made out of brown wooden parts.

Reinforced wooden torso and arms.

Wooden horn on head.

Has two neon green eyes and a neon green core in its torso.
}}
|Fallen
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:FallenHallowGuard.png|200px]]
|Made entirely of black parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid.

Grey chestplate, blue shoulder-pads with blue crystals, brown scarf, belt and hood, blue crystal on chestplate, grey bandages around arms and blue horn on head.

Does not have a full torso, but instead has a partial ribcage.

Has two large blue flaming eyeholes with blue liquid coming out of it.
}}
|Duck
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:DuckHallowGuard.png|200px]]
|Large white ducky with black eyes, an orange beak and flippers, and blue stripes under its eyes.

Wears a grey and yellow helmet, vest, wing-pad and flipper-pads.
}}
|Creepy Santa
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:CreepySantaHallowGuard.png|200px]]
|White snowman with snow arms, blue stone eyes and green buttons, carrot nose, sharp blue teeth and ice spikes covering its body.

Wields an ice spear, though this weapon is cosmetic.
}}
